title: Institute of Health courses
description: A grey band with a large three-line statement and a dark button, then an auto-playing course carousel: square-ish cards in a row with the active one centred, white and fully opaque while the others sit on page-grey at 45%. A white bar above the active card shows its category and unit count; a white overview box under it rises 16px into place each time the track slides one card left (0.8s, every 4s, paused on hover). Phones show one wide card with the neighbours peeking.
notes: needs JavaScript for the autoplay and clicks (hydrate: visible)
autoplay is off under reduced motion; clicking a card centres it
